title: Variable bound after relabeling
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a CNF formula over a type of variables, let $w$ map each variable to a natural-number index, and let $N$ be a natural number. Suppose every literal variable occurring in every clause of $\varphi$ is mapped by $w$ to an index strictly less than $N$. Then the variable count of the formula obtained by relabeling $\varphi$ with $w$ is at most $N$.
hypotheses_covered: A map from variables to natural numbers
Every variable in every clause maps to an index less than $N$
